values.note: George Washington and Jefferson National Forests dispersed camping: no reservations, no facilities; 14 days in any 30-day period at one location. No camping in or within 300 feet of any developed parking area or boat ramp, or near trailheads and other developed recreation areas; keep the campsite within 150 feet of the road and at least 100 feet from water.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins ('Recreationist can camp anywhere in the National Forest outside a designated campground. Expect little to no facilities', 'Dispersed camping in one location is allowable up to 14 days in any 30-day period.', 'Dispersed camping is not allowed in the vicinity of developed recreation areas such as campgrounds, picnic areas, or trailheads. Many sites can be found along Forest Service roads with existing clearings ... Keep your campsite within 150 feet from a roadway.', 'Camp at least 100 feet from any stream or other water source.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts/general-prohibitions (Forest Order 08-08-00-23-3, effective to August 30, 2028: 'Camping or maintaining a campsite for a period of time exceeding 14 days in any 30-day period', 'Camping in or within 300 feet of any developed parking area or boat ramp' prohibited), read 2026-10-21

note: Numerous forest service campsites along the length of FR 344. Suitable for most vehicles. FR 344 is a seasonal Forest Service road, open to motor vehicles April 1 - January 15 (Forest Service Motor Vehicle Use Map). --Claude
summary: Checked the five FR 344 'Squirrel Gap' sites together (397-401). No Forest Service page names them; booking set from the George Washington and Jefferson NF's dispersed-camping rules and forest order: first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 30 (adds booking). FS road data: FR 344 is a level-3 gravel road suitable for passenger cars, open to motorhomes April 1 - January 15 (added to the note, since no field holds a road season). No current alert or closure. Free fee (AWH, manual) left. Not stated by any agency page: site count, rig size, facilities. Pin is ~8120 m from the paved parking lot at the US-48 end of FR 344, outside the order's 300-ft (91 m) buffer.
flags: Missing website: no Forest Service page designates or names campsites on FR 344; the George Washington and Jefferson NF has no recreation page for Squirrel Gap. Agency pages that govern it: the forest's dispersed-camping page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins and the General Prohibitions forest order https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts/general-prohibitions. Missing phone: Lee Ranger District, Edinburg VA, 540-984-4101 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/offices).

Road, for information: Forest Service Motor Vehicle Use Map data (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_MVUM_01/MapServer/1, queried 2026-10-21): the pin is on NFSR WV344 'Squirrel Gap', Lee Ranger District, George Washington and Jefferson National Forest; maintenance level '3 - SUITABLE FOR PASSENGER CARS', crushed aggregate/gravel, 'Roads open to highway legal vehicles only, Seasonal': motorhomes (and passenger cars) open 04/01-01/15, so the road is closed to vehicles January 16 - March 31. No current George Washington and Jefferson alert or forest order closes FR 344 (alerts page read 2026-10-21). No agency page recommends high clearance or 4WD.
Managing agency: George Washington and Jefferson National Forests, Lee Ranger District (FS road layer admin org 080804; MVUM districtname 'Lee Ranger District'); ownership federal is right.
Criteria (unconfirmed): no agency page says a 23-ft motorhome fits the site; the entry's inclusion rests on Campendium/The Dyrt.
